verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that users can register and sign in to Entra without passwords using passkeys (FIDO2) on security keys, native or third-party passkey providers, or Microsoft Authenticator. That covers the core passkey and authenticator paths of the story. Community reports of a FIDO downgrade attack depend on fallback methods being enabled; they do not show that passwordless sign-in fails to work, so they lower confidence slightly rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of platform biometrics (e.g., Windows Hello) as a passwordless method, independent hands-on corroboration of the employee sign-in flow.
